factoryIntro.title: Where custom figurines get made

factoryIntro.p2: Ventilated casting rooms, dust-controlled paint booths, calibrated airbrush stations, low-VOC resins. We invested in the room before we ever invested in the production line.

magicalMemories.p3: Our creations are more than toys — they are collectibles, keepsakes, and the physical form of the worlds your audience already loves.

items.a: We start at 100 units for hand-painted resin figures. Below that we can still help with a one-off prototype, but per-piece cost rises sharply since the mold setup is the same regardless of run size.

Typical timeline from approved 3D sculpt to first shipment is 28–35 working days. Sculpting itself adds 5–10 days depending on complexity. We send weekly photo updates so you always know where your batch is.

Yes — fully free, no obligation, no IP transfer until you place a production order. We deliver a 360° turntable render and (on request) one printed physical proof at our cost. We absorb this because it's the cheapest way for both sides to discover whether your project is a fit.

items.q: Do you handle CE / EN71 / ASTM testing?
items.a: Yes. We test the resin, paints and packaging in accredited labs (SGS / Intertek) for CE, EN71-1/2/3, ASTM F963 and REACH. Test reports are included in your shipment so retail buyers can audit them.

items.q: What payment terms do you accept?
items.a: Standard terms: 30% deposit to lock the production slot, 70% balance before shipment. We accept wire transfer (T/T), Alibaba Trade Assurance, and PayPal for sample-stage payments. For repeat clients we extend net-30 terms after the third order.

Yes. We ship by sea (FCL/LCL), air (DHL/FedEx/UPS), or rail (China–Europe). For runs under 200 units, air courier is usually most economical. We handle export documentation, HS codes, and country-of-origin certificates.

items.q: Do you require a contract or NDA?
items.a: We sign client NDAs as a default — your sculpts, art and IP stay protected. We never reuse a custom-sculpted figure for another client, and we destroy molds on request when a production cycle ends.

items.q: Can I visit the factory in Shenzhen?
items.a: Of course. We host client visits year-round, and have hosted production walk-throughs for buyers from 25+ countries. Send us your dates and we'll arrange airport pickup, hotel recommendations, and a one-day tour of sculpt → mold → cast → paint → pack.

about.heroSubtitle: A 50-person factory of sculptors, mould-makers, casters, painters and QA — turning ideas into hand-painted resin figures since 2013.
about.storyP1: We started in 2013 with one silicone mould, a single airbrush, and a stack of concept sketches on a coffee table. Twelve years later, we're still small — about 50 people in a 1,200㎡ factory — but we now ship for brands across 25+ countries.
about.storyP2: We hand-paint every figure. We treat every order — 100 pieces or 10,000 — like the most important order of the day. Because for someone, somewhere, it is.
about.factorySubtitle: We don't outsource. Every step happens in our own facility — so we can stand behind every brushstroke.
about.teamSubtitle: Sculptors, mould-makers, casters, painters, QA and packers — a small team where everyone knows the figures going out the door.

team.note: Every piece inspected, tray-packed by hand.

values.heroSubtitle: What we actually care about — and how it shows up in the day-to-day, not just on a poster in the lobby.

principles.title: Made by People
principles.desc: Every figure is cast, hand-painted and finished by a person. The tiny brushstroke quirks you'll spot aren't bugs — they're how you know a human made it.

principles.title: No Middlemen
principles.desc: We make everything in our own factory. We'll send you photos from the floor whenever you ask. No trading-company runaround.

principles.title: Safe Enough for Kids
principles.desc: CE / EN71 / ASTM resin, low-VOC paint, REACH-compliant primers, child-safe edges. We test every batch — not once a year for a certificate.

principles.title: Fewer, Better Orders
principles.desc: We don't chase every job. We pick clients we'd be happy to keep working with — and we end up with less waste because of it.

principles.title: The Greener Option, by Default
principles.desc: Reusable silicone molds, recyclable inner trays, FSC paper boxes, no plastic mailers. The greener option is just the only one we stock.

values.peopleTitle: Good figures start with people who are doing OK
values.peopleIntro: Fair pay. Reasonable hours. A factory that's safe, quiet and non-toxic. That's not a perk list — that's the basics. If our team is doing well, your order tends to turn out well too.

commitments.title: Fair Pay, On Time
commitments.desc: Wages above the local median. Overtime paid as overtime. Salaries hit the bank on the 10th of every month, every month.

commitments.title: Reasonable Hours
commitments.desc: 8-hour days. Overtime only if you say yes. Days off mean days off. We won't burn the team out to hit a deadline.

commitments.title: A Factory That's Nice to Be In
commitments.desc: Air-con, decent lighting, chairs that don't wreck your back, machines that aren't loud. We spent money on the room before we spent it on the production line.

commitments.title: Non-Toxic Materials
commitments.desc: Resins, paints, primers and packaging — all skin-safe and low-VOC. The collectors handling the figures are protected, and so are the people casting and painting them all day.

commitments.title: Insurance, Done Properly
commitments.desc: Social insurance, medical insurance, housing fund, yearly health check-ups. We follow the law to the letter — for everyone, every year.

commitments.title: Family Comes First
commitments.desc: Leave on time. Take your annual leave. Make it to your kid's school play. The figures will still get made — probably better, actually.

values.manifestoTitle: We're not a sweatshop. We never will be.
values.manifestoP1: Our job is to help you make a great product — and to let the team go home in time to take care of theirs. When the people sculpting and painting your figures feel rested and respected, the seams sit cleaner, QA catches more, and the tiny details actually survive into mass production.
values.manifestoP2: That's the deal we offer the team. It's also the quiet promise behind every order.
values.teamSubtitle: Sculptors, mould-makers, casters, painters, QA, packers. A small group looking after each other and your order at the same time.
values.teamCaption: Refreshed every quarter — the team grows, the wall grows.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How Shenzhen Heli Toys Co., Ltd. (operating as Resin Factory) collects, uses and protects the personal information you share with us through resin-factory.com.

sections.title: 1. What we collect
body: When you submit a quote inquiry through our contact form, we collect: your name, company name, work email, phone (optional), the product type and quantity you're interested in, your project message, and any reference files you attach. We also automatically log your IP address and the language version of the site you used, for spam-prevention and analytics purposes.
We do not collect or store payment information through this site. Any payment-related conversation happens by email or signed contract after we've spoken with you.

sections.title: 2. How we use your information
body: We use the information you provide solely to reply to your inquiry, prepare a quote, and (if you become a client) manage your project. We may follow up by email if we believe a new product or service is directly relevant to a previous inquiry — you can opt out of these by replying with 'unsubscribe.'
We do not sell, rent, or trade your data to any third party. We do not use it for advertising. We do not share it with marketing platforms.

sections.title: 3. Where your data lives
body: Inquiry emails are stored on Hostinger's email servers (henry@resin-factory.com inbox). Our website is hosted with Hostinger. We do not run a separate database of contact records — your inquiry email IS the record.
We retain inquiry emails for up to 5 years from the date of your last contact with us, after which they are permanently deleted. You can request earlier deletion at any time.

sections.title: 4. Cookies & analytics
body: This website does not set tracking cookies. We do not use Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, or any third-party analytics tool. The only cookie our site may set is a session cookie required for the language preference, and it expires when you close your browser.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete the personal data we hold about you. To exercise any of these rights, email henry@resin-factory.com with your request. We respond within 5 working days.

If you're located in the EU, UK, or California, you have additional rights under GDPR / UK GDPR / CCPA — including the right to data portability and the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

sections.title: 6. Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy when we change how we collect or use data, or when the law requires it. Material changes will be flagged on this page with a new 'last updated' date. Continued use of the site after a change constitutes acceptance of the new policy.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: The terms governing your use of resin-factory.com and any quote, sample, or production order placed with Shenzhen Heli Toys Co., Ltd.

sections.title: 1. Use of this website
body: You may browse, share, and reference content on resin-factory.com freely for non-commercial purposes. You may not scrape, mirror, or republish substantial portions of the site without written permission. You may not use the site or our contact form to send unsolicited commercial messages, harassment, or unlawful content.

sections.title: 2. Quote inquiries are non-binding
body: Submitting an inquiry through our contact form does not create a contract. Quotes we provide are valid for 30 days from the date of issue. Production begins only after a written purchase order is signed by both parties and the deposit (typically 30% of the order value) is received.

sections.title: 3. Intellectual property
body: Any artwork, sketches, 3D files, brand assets or character IP you share with us remains your property. We will not reuse, modify, license, or display your IP without written consent. Sample physical figures we ship to you are yours.

Conversely, the photos, illustrations, written content and brand identity on resin-factory.com are owned by Shenzhen Heli Toys Co., Ltd. — you may not reproduce them in your own marketing without permission.

When we sculpt or design something custom for your order, you own the rights to the design (subject to your IP being yours to begin with). We retain the right to keep behind-the-scenes process photos for our own portfolio unless you explicitly opt out.

sections.title: 4. Production, delivery & defects
body: Production timelines we quote are working-day estimates based on standard complexity. Significant scope changes mid-production may extend the timeline; we will always communicate this in writing.

Hand-painted resin figures are inspected piece-by-piece before packing. Acceptable variation between hand-painted units is part of the product — Pantone-perfect uniformity is achievable but requires a discussion at quote stage. We replace defective units (paint flaws, broken pieces, missing accessories) at our cost when reported within 30 days of delivery.

sections.title: 5. Limitation of liability
body: Our total liability under any order is capped at the value of that order. We are not liable for indirect, consequential, or lost-profit damages, including but not limited to missed sales windows, delayed product launches, or third-party retailer cancellations beyond our control.

sections.title: 6. Governing law & disputes
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China. Any dispute we cannot resolve amicably will be referred to the China International Economic and Trade Arbitration Commission (CIETAC), Shenzhen sub-commission, with proceedings in English.

shipping.title: Shipping & Returns
shipping.intro: How we ship custom resin figures from Shenzhen worldwide, what to expect at customs, and how we handle damage or defects in transit.

sections.title: 1. Shipping methods
body: We ship by sea (FCL or LCL containers), air courier (DHL, FedEx, UPS), or rail (China–Europe). For runs under 200 finished units, air courier is usually fastest and cheapest landed. For 1,000+ units, sea is dramatically more economical despite longer transit.
We quote freight as an option on every quote — you can choose to use our forwarder or arrange your own pickup ex-works (EXW) from our Shenzhen warehouse.

sections.title: 2. Lead times after production
body: Door-to-door transit from Shenzhen to most major hubs: DHL/FedEx/UPS air courier — 3 to 7 business days. China-to-Europe rail — 22 to 28 days. Sea freight (FCL) to US West Coast — 18 to 25 days, to US East Coast — 28 to 35 days, to EU main ports — 32 to 40 days. Sea (LCL) typically adds 5 to 10 days for consolidation.

sections.title: 3. Customs, duties & taxes
body: Quotes are typically priced FOB Shenzhen unless you ask for DDP (delivery duty paid). For FOB shipments you are responsible for import duties, VAT/GST, and customs clearance fees in the destination country.
We provide all standard documentation: commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or air waybill, certificate of origin (if requested), and CE/EN71/ASTM test reports for the products inside.

sections.title: 4. Damage in transit
body: All shipments are insured up to invoice value through our forwarder. If your shipment arrives with visible carton damage, photograph it before opening, note 'damaged' on the courier's POD, and contact us within 7 calendar days. We file the carrier claim and replace damaged units at our cost.

For damage discovered after opening (single broken figures, paint scuffs from transit), photograph and email us within 14 days of delivery. Standard remedy is replacement units shipped with your next order, or a credit applied to that next order — your choice.

sections.title: 5. Returns
body: Custom-made resin figures are non-returnable for buyer's-remorse reasons (we made them specifically for you and cannot resell them). Returns are accepted only for: defects we missed at QA, mis-painting against the approved master sample, missing units, or wrong product entirely. In those cases we replace at our cost on the next available production cycle, typically within 15 working days of confirmation.

sections.title: 6. Warranty
body: Our hand-painted resin figures are warranted against manufacturing defects for 12 months from date of delivery. Normal wear, mishandling, drops, exposure to direct sunlight, or display in high-humidity environments are not covered. Spare-parts service (replacement bases, accessories) is available on request for repeat clients.
